item.coloph: sbyor pa brgya pa zhes bya ba'i sman gyi gzhung 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /bal po'i paN+Di ta chen po bram se dze ta kar+NA'i zhal snga nas dang po rtsa 'grel lan cig gsungs shing / dus phyis rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paN+Di ta bud+d+ha shrI dz+nyA na'i zhal snga nas stod cung zad gsungs nas/ grub pa'i zhing skyid rong 'phags pa 'jig rten dbang po'i gtsug lag khang la cung zad las mi ring ba/ chen po'i chen po rnams kyi gdan sa dpal shar gyi gtsug lag khang du/ sdom brtson dam pa sde sned gsum dang / rgyud dang rgyud kyi yan lag rnams las legs par 'dris shing / khyad par du tshe'i rig byed yan lag brgyad pa'i snying po bsdus pa'i gzhung don legs par rtogs pa dge slong a mo g+ha'i gsung gis bskul nas/ mang du thos pa'i lo tsA ba shAkya'i dge slong dpal nyi ma rgyal mtshan bzang pos 'grel pa gsum dang bstun te bsgyur zhing legs pa gtan la phab pa'o/ /gso dpyad gzhung lugs brgya phrag du ma'i gnad/ sna tshogs mngon brjod tha dad sdeb sbyor can/ ya mtshan rgyan la legs sbyar tshig gis spel/ gang 'di bsgyur dges nad rnams zhi bar shog /sa steng du nyi ma dang zla ba ltar gyur cig /lo tsA ba'i 'gyur bstan la dpe phyi byas nas bris te zhus dag legs par bgyis pa 'dis/ sems can dpag tu med pa'i don byed par gyur cig
